failure_if_out_of_range: PTO shaft bottoms out or separates during operation
repair_actions: Place Rotavator on a firm level surface and adjust depth control equipment until the Gearbox Input Shaft is horizontal.
Position tractor at a distance from the Rotavator to ensure a minimum of 150 mm (6 inches) engagement of the male half of the PTO shaft in the female tube.
embedding_text:
SPECIFICATION
COMPONENT: Pto Drive Shaft
TYPE: clearance
VALUE: 150 mm

FAILS IF:
- PTO shaft bottoms out or separates during operation

REPAIR:
- Place Rotavator on a firm level surface and adjust depth control equipment until the Gearbox Input Shaft is horizontal.
- Position tractor at a distance from the Rotavator to ensure a minimum of 150 mm (6 inches) engagement of the male half of the PTO shaft in the female tube.

failure_if_out_of_range: PTO shaft exceeds maximum operating angle
repair_actions: Attach PTO Drive Shaft to tractor ensuring quick release pin engages spline shaft groove.
Attach stabiliser bar or check chains to limit sway to 50 mm (2”).
Lift Rotavator until PTO Drive Shaft attains an angle of 40o and set limit stop on hydraulic lift control quadrant.

SPECIFICATION
COMPONENT: Pto Drive Shaft
TYPE: clearance
VALUE: 50 mm

FAILS IF:
- PTO shaft bottoms out
- PTO shaft separates
- PTO shaft exceeds maximum operating angle

REPAIR:
- Attach PTO Drive Shaft to tractor ensuring quick release pin engages spline shaft groove.
- Attach stabiliser bar or check chains to limit sway to 50 mm (2”).
- Lift Rotavator until PTO Drive Shaft attains an angle of 40o and set limit stop on hydraulic lift control quadrant.

SPECIFICATION
COMPONENT: Howard Blade Bolt
TYPE: torque
VALUE: 200 N·m

FAILS IF:
- Blade detachment
- Excessive vibration
- Damage to rotor flange

REPAIR:
- Insert Howard blade bolt through blade and flange, ensuring bolt head is against the blade and spring washer/nut are against the flange.
- Tighten the nut to a torque of 200 Nm.
